page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (small italic references and notes beside the lines).

main_text.p: „ nemo propterea bene operatur, vt ac- „ cipiat gratiam, sed quia accepit: ideoq; „ nec præuidit Deus bona cuiusquam o- „ pera, nisi quæ dare iam constitutum „ apud se habebat.

Sed enim defensa olim fide catholi- ca contra Pelagianos, & expugnato eo- rum errore ab orthodoxis Episcopis, præsertim Augustino, insigni patrono fidei, vt ab Hilario iure laudatus est; emerserunt alij nonnulli clari atque egregij in omni virtutum studio viri, nisi quòd spiritus Pelagianæ impietatis iis illusit; Semipelagiani idcirco appel- „ lati. Horum definitio ac professio erat, „ omnes quidem homines Adamo pec- „ cante peccasse, & neminem per opera „ sua, sed per Dei gratiam regeneratio- ne saluari: vnicuique tamen tantum re- liquum esse gratiæ naturalis, vt ad iftam saluantem gratiam, initialis gratiæ ope „ queat peruenire, si velit. Itaque quan- „ tum ad Deum pertinet, omnibus para- „ tam vitam æternam: quantum autem ad „ arbitrij libertatem, ab his eam appre- „ hendi, qui Deo sponte, tanquam ex se, cre-Epistola eius ad Augustinum tom. 7.Semipelagiani.Vide dicta Epist. vt & Epist. pro- speri ibi- dem.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are small and partly abbreviated; their readings are approximate. "Epistola eius ad Augustinum" and the "tom. 7" reference are read from small italic type. The catchword "cre-" is a hyphenated word at the foot of the page, printed as the last line.
